about_the_game:
Hero steps into the Card Dungeon to face the ultimate trial. This is a tactical game that fuses poker hand combos with dungeon crawling. Wield the full 52 card deck against waves of monsters and hidden bosses. Every battle plays differently.

Master damage through hand combinations, smart discards and draws, and careful potion use. Survive under Shield and Rage states that change tempo and risk. Random events, side deck draws, and elite encounters keep each run unpredictable.

Defeat the Skeleton King and the final boss to escape the depths and claim upgrades and glory. Fail, and only ashes of legend remain. Do you have the courage and cardcraft to write an immortal chapter?

Music credit: The Fury by Scott Buckley - released under CC BY 4.0.

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains mild fantasy violence and battles with skeleton monsters, no sexual or gore content.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 18.04 或更新版本 / SteamOS 3.0 或更新版本
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-4000 系列或 AMD 同等級處理器
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM MB RAM
  • Graphics: 支援 OpenGL 3.2 的整合顯示卡或獨立顯示卡
  • Storage: 2 GB MB available space
  • Sound Card: 任何支援 DirectSound 的音效卡
  • VR Support: 不支援
  • Additional Notes: - 支援鍵盤和滑鼠操作 - 建議螢幕解析度 1280x720 或更高 - 支援全螢幕和視窗模式

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 11 Big Sur（Apple Silicon）或 macOS 10.15 Catalina（Intel）
  • Processor: Apple M1 或 Intel Core i3（雙核心 2.0GHz 以上）
  • Memory: 4096 MB RAM
  • Graphics: 內建 GPU（Apple 內顯 / Intel HD 4000 以上）
  • Storage: 600 MB available space
  • Sound Card: 內建音效
  • Additional Notes: Electron 2D 卡牌遊戲；提供 arm64 與 x64（或 Universal）版本；支援 1280×720 以上解析度。

name: Dungeon & Poker

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10（64 位元）
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 或 AMD Ryzen 3（雙核心 2.0GHz 以上）
  • Memory: 4096 MB RAM
  • Graphics: 內建顯示（Intel HD 4000 / Radeon R5 以上；支援 OpenGL 3.3 或 DX11）
  • Storage: 600 MB available space
  • Sound Card: 內建音效
  • Additional Notes: 需要 64 位元系統；鍵盤/滑鼠或控制器皆可。

short_description: ⚔️ Enter the Dungeon of Cards! A unique roguelike where a 52-card deck is your only weapon. Build poker hands, manage swaps and potions, and face monsters, elite foes, and mighty bosses. Defeat the Skeleton King to claim glory—or fall into legend. 🃏
supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Korean, Portuguese - Portugal
